sentence: Active: 'Submit the official audit report before Friday.'
correctAnswer: Let the official audit report be submitted before Friday.

steps.step1_marker: Sentence Type Analysis: Active sentence base verb 'Submit' se shuru ho raha hai aur direct command/instruction express kar raha hai. Subject 'You' implied (hidden) hai.
steps.step2_time: Object Identification: Transitive verb 'Submit' ke baad direct object 'the official audit report' maujood hai.
steps.step3_aspect: Formula Selection: Direct command with object ke liye standard textbook formula lagayein: 'Let + Object + be + V3'.
steps.step4_inflection: Auxiliary & V3 Assembly: 'Let' ke baad object 'the official audit report' aaya, fir auxiliary 'be', aur main verb 'submit' ka V3 form 'submitted' lagaya.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'Let the official audit report be submitted before Friday.'

trapWarning: EXAM TRAP: Active mein 'should' ya 'you are ordered' tabhi chunein jab 'Let' wala option missing ho ya context specifically order/advice mention kare. Examination grammar mein standard transitive command ke liye 'Let + obj + be + V3' first preference hota hai.

sentence: Active: 'Please grant me an extension of two weeks to file the reply.'
correctAnswer: You are requested to grant me an extension of two weeks to file the reply.

steps.step1_marker: Tone & Politeness Marker: Active sentence mein word 'Please' laga hai, jo clearly darshata hai ki speaker polite request kar raha hai.
steps.step2_time: Formula Determination: Polite request ke liye situational passive formula: 'You are requested to + V1 + Object'.
steps.step3_aspect: Redundancy Elimination: Passive formula mein 'requested' verb aane se 'Please' ka meaning already absorb ho jata hai, isliye 'Please' ko drop karein.
steps.step4_inflection: Infinitive Construction: Main verb 'grant' base infinitive form ('to grant') mein retain rehti hai.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'You are requested to grant me an extension of two weeks to file the reply.'

trapWarning: SUPERFLUOUS WORD TRAP: 'You are requested to please grant...' likhna grammatically redundant hai. Option mein se 'please' drop hona mandatory hai.

sentence: Active: 'Do not disclose the confidential court cipher.'
correctAnswer: Let the confidential court cipher not be disclosed.

steps.step1_marker: Polarity & Structure: Active sentence 'Do not' se shuru ho raha hai aur direct object 'the confidential court cipher' hai.
steps.step2_time: Negative Placement Rule: Negative imperative formula: 'Let + Object + not + be + V3'.
steps.step3_aspect: Object Promotion: Object 'the confidential court cipher' ko 'Let' ke baad promote karein.
steps.step4_inflection: Word Order Check: 'Not' ko auxiliary 'be' se theek pehle place karein, aur 'disclose' ka V3 'disclosed' lagayein.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'Let the confidential court cipher not be disclosed.'

trapWarning: WORD ORDER TRAP: Distractor options mein aksar 'Let the cipher be not disclosed' diya jata hai. 'Not' hamesha 'be' se pehle aana chahiye: 'not be disclosed'.

sentence: Active: 'Respect the judicial verdicts of the High Court.'
correctAnswer: The judicial verdicts of the High Court should be respected.

steps.step1_marker: Semantic Tone Check: Sentence kisi coercing order ya personal request ka nahi, balki ek civic duty aur moral obligation ka hai.
steps.step2_time: Formula Selection: Moral advice/duty ke liye standard passive formula: 'Object + should be + V3'.
steps.step3_aspect: Object Promotion: Direct object 'The judicial verdicts of the High Court' sentence ka naya subject banega.
steps.step4_inflection: Modal Auxiliary & V3: Modal 'should' ke baad 'be' aur verb 'respect' ka past participle 'respected' aayega.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'The judicial verdicts of the High Court should be respected.'

trapWarning: TONE MISMATCH: 'Let the judicial verdicts be respected' ki tulna mein 'should be respected' contextually far superior aur exam-preferred option hota hai.

correctAnswer: You are ordered to leave the courtroom immediately.

steps.step1_marker: Transitivity Check: Verb 'Leave' ke baad koi direct object nahi hai ('the courtroom' place adverbial/locative complement hai, aur sentence authoritative command hai).
steps.step2_time: Feasibility Determination: Intransitive imperative sentences ka 'Let' se passive nahi ban sakta (jaise 'Let the courtroom be left' unnatural aur grammatically incorrect hai).
steps.step3_aspect: Situational Passive Formula: Authoritative order ke liye situational formula lagayein: 'You are ordered to + V1'.
steps.step4_inflection: Infinitive Construction: 'to leave the courtroom immediately' jod dein.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'You are ordered to leave the courtroom immediately.'

trapWarning: PSEUDO-PASSIVE TRAP: Intransitive commands mein kabhi 'Let' lagane ki koshish na karein. Wahan strictly 'You are ordered / commanded to' hi correct hota hai.

sentence: Active: 'The administrative officer can approve this urgent expenditure.'
correctAnswer: This urgent expenditure can be approved by the administrative officer.

steps.step1_marker: Component Isolation: Subject = 'The administrative officer', Modal + Verb = 'can approve', Object = 'this urgent expenditure'.
steps.step2_time: Modal Invariance Rule: Active sentence mein modal 'can' hai. Voice change mein modal badalna nahi chahiye ('can' 'can' hi rahega, 'could' nahi banega).
steps.step3_aspect: Formula Application: Simple Modal Passive = 'Object + Modal + be + V3 + (by + Subject)'.
steps.step4_inflection: Auxiliary & V3 Assembly: 'can' ke baad 'be' aayega aur 'approve' ka V3 'approved' banega.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'This urgent expenditure can be approved by the administrative officer.'

trapWarning: BACKSHIFTING ERROR: Option mein 'could be approved' diya hoga jo Narration ka rule hai. Voice mein tense aur modal strictly preserve rehte hain.

sentence: Active: 'All candidates must produce their original identity cards.'
correctAnswer: Original identity cards must be produced by all candidates.

steps.step1_marker: Component Isolation: Subject = 'All candidates', Modal = 'must', Verb = 'produce', Object = 'their original identity cards'.
steps.step2_time: Modal Meaning Preservation: 'Must' strict legal compulsion express kar raha hai. Ye passive mein intact rahega.
steps.step3_aspect: Object Promotion: Object 'Original identity cards' naya subject ban gaya.
steps.step4_inflection: Auxiliary & V3: 'must be produced' ban gaya. Agent 'by all candidates' end mein add hua.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'Original identity cards must be produced by all candidates.'

trapWarning: MODAL SUBSTITUTION: Distractor options 'should be produced' ya 'had to be produced' dekar meaning dilute karte hain. Original modal 'must' retain hona chahiye.

sentence: Active: 'The court cannot entertain an uncertified revision petition.'
correctAnswer: An uncertified revision petition cannot be entertained by the court.

steps.step1_marker: Component Isolation: Subject = 'The court', Verb Phrase = 'cannot entertain', Object = 'an uncertified revision petition'.
steps.step2_time: Negation Order: Negative modal formula: 'Object + Modal + not + be + V3 + (by + Subject)'.
steps.step3_aspect: Object Promotion: 'An uncertified revision petition' sentence ka naya subject bana.
steps.step4_inflection: Auxiliary & V3: 'cannot be entertained' (note: 'cannot' single word ya 'can not' valid hai).
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'An uncertified revision petition cannot be entertained by the court.'

trapWarning: WORD ORDER DISCORD: 'can be not entertained' bilkul galat word order hai. Negation 'not' hamesha modal ke turant baad aati hai.

sentence: Active: 'Can the cyber forensic expert retrieve the deleted server logs?'
correctAnswer: Can the deleted server logs be retrieved by the cyber forensic expert?

steps.step1_marker: Interrogative Syntax Check: Sentence Yes/No question hai jo modal 'Can' se shuru ho raha hai.
steps.step2_time: Inversion Rule: Interrogative passive mein bhi modal auxiliary subject se pehle sentence ke start mein inverted rahegi.
steps.step3_aspect: Question Formula: 'Modal + Object + be + V3 + (by + Subject)?'.
steps.step4_inflection: Component Placement: 'Can' + [the deleted server logs] + 'be retrieved' + [by the cyber forensic expert]?
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'Can the deleted server logs be retrieved by the cyber forensic expert?'

trapWarning: ASSERTIVE WORD ORDER TRAP: Distractor mein 'Can be the deleted server logs retrieved...?' ya 'The deleted server logs can be retrieved...?' dekar question syntax corrupt kiya jata hai.

sentence: Active: 'The registry should have dispatched the summons yesterday.'
correctAnswer: The summons should have been dispatched by the registry yesterday.

steps.step1_marker: Component Isolation: Subject = 'The registry', Verb = 'should have dispatched' (Modal Perfect), Object = 'the summons'.
steps.step2_time: Temporal Reference: 'Should have dispatched' past unfulfilled duty ko indicate kar raha hai.
steps.step3_aspect: Modal Perfect Passive Formula: 'Object + Modal + have been + V3 + (by + Subject)'.
steps.step4_inflection: Auxiliary Chain: 'should' + 'have been' + 'dispatched'. (Note: 'summons' singular noun hone ke bawajood modal ke baad 'have' hi aayega, 'has' nahi).
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'The summons should have been dispatched by the registry yesterday.'

trapWarning: BEEN OMISSION BLUNDER: Agar option mein 'The summons should have dispatched...' ho, toh 'been' missing hai. Ye active voice hi reh jata hai aur completely wrong hota hai.

sentence: Active: 'Someone must have tampered with the electronic seal.'
correctAnswer: The electronic seal must have been tampered with.
tense: Modal Perfect with Prepositional Verb & Indefinite Agent

steps.step1_marker: Component Isolation: Subject = 'Someone' (indefinite pronoun), Verb = 'must have tampered with' (Modal Perfect + Prepositional Verb), Object = 'the electronic seal'.
steps.step2_time: Double Rule Application: (1) Modal perfect passive rule ('must have been + V3'), aur (2) Preposition retention rule ('with' verb ke sath rahega).
steps.step3_aspect: Agent Omission Check: Subject 'Someone' vague/indefinite hai, isliye passive mein 'by someone' naturally omit ho jayega.
steps.step4_inflection: Auxiliary & Particle: 'must have been tampered with' poora compound unit ek sath aayega.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'The electronic seal must have been tampered with.'

trapWarning: DROPPED PREPOSITION: 'The electronic seal must have been tampered' mein 'with' missing hai, jo sentence ko grammatically incomplete aur unacceptable banata hai.

sentence: Active: 'The division bench looked into the election dispute thoroughly.'
correctAnswer: The election dispute was looked into thoroughly by the division bench.

steps.step1_marker: Component Isolation: Subject = 'The division bench', Verb = 'looked into' (Simple Past Prepositional Verb), Object = 'the election dispute'.
steps.step2_time: Tense Identification: Active verb 'looked' Simple Past (V2) hai, isliye passive auxiliary 'was/were' hogi.
steps.step3_aspect: Preposition Retention Check: Preposition 'into' verb phrase ka core hissa hai (look into = investigate), isko drop nahi kiya ja sakta.
steps.step4_inflection: Passive Construction: Naya subject singular ('The election dispute') hai, isliye 'was looked into' aayega.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'The election dispute was looked into thoroughly by the division bench.'

trapWarning: PREPOSITION DROPPING: Option mein 'was looked thoroughly by...' diya hoga. Fixed preposition 'into' drop karna exam ka top distractor hai.

sentence: Active: 'We should never laugh at the misfortune of others.'
correctAnswer: The misfortune of others should never be laughed at by us.

steps.step1_marker: Component Isolation: Subject = 'We', Modal + Adv + Verb = 'should never laugh at', Object = 'the misfortune of others'.
steps.step2_time: Preposition Retention: 'laugh at' ek fixed prepositional unit hai. Passive mein 'at' verb ke baad bana rahega.
steps.step3_aspect: Formula Application: 'Object + Modal + never be + V3 + Preposition + (by + Subject)'.
steps.step4_inflection: Adverb & Auxiliary Chain: 'should never be laughed at' assemble karein.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'The misfortune of others should never be laughed at by us.'

trapWarning: DOUBLE PREPOSITION IS VALID: Agar option mein 'laughed at by us' aaye, toh mat sochiye ki 'at' aur 'by' ek sath nahi aa sakte. 'at' verb ka hissa hai aur 'by' agent marker hai.

sentence: Active: 'The administrative staff called off the pen-down strike.'
correctAnswer: The pen-down strike was called off by the administrative staff.

steps.step1_marker: Component Isolation: Subject = 'The administrative staff', Verb = 'called off' (Simple Past phrasal verb), Object = 'the pen-down strike'.
steps.step2_time: Tense & Aspect: Simple Past V2 hai, naya subject singular hai, isliye auxiliary 'was' aayegi.
steps.step3_aspect: Particle Retention: 'off' adverbial particle hai jo 'called' ke sath judkar 'cancel' ka meaning deta hai. Ye V3 ke sath intact rahega.
steps.step4_inflection: Passive Verb: 'was called off' assemble hua.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'The pen-down strike was called off by the administrative staff.'

trapWarning: PARTICLE DROPPING: Agar 'off' drop karke sirf 'was called' likha jaye, toh sentence ka meaning cancel hone ki jagah bulaane (summon) ka ban jayega.

sentence: Active: 'The Chief Justice granted the petitioner interim protection.'
correctAnswer: The petitioner was granted interim protection by the Chief Justice.
tense: Bi-Transitive Verb with Two Objects (Indirect Object Promoted)

steps.step1_marker: Component Isolation: Subject = 'The Chief Justice', Verb = 'granted' (Simple Past), Indirect Object (IO, Person) = 'the petitioner', Direct Object (DO, Thing) = 'interim protection'.
steps.step2_time: Two-Path Evaluation: Path 1 (IO promoted): 'The petitioner was granted interim protection...'. Path 2 (DO promoted): 'Interim protection was granted TO the petitioner...'.
steps.step3_aspect: Natural Preference: Standard English mein person (IO) ko promote karna zyada natural aur formal mana jata hai.
steps.step4_inflection: Auxiliary Check: Simple Past singular subject 'The petitioner' ke liye auxiliary 'was granted' lagaya.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'The petitioner was granted interim protection by the Chief Justice.'

trapWarning: DIRECT OBJECT PREPOSITION TRAP: Agar Path 2 choose karein, toh 'Interim protection was granted the petitioner' bina 'to' ke bilkul galat hoga. Wahan 'granted TO the petitioner' aana mandatory hai.
